metadata.description: Ngân hàng câu hỏi gốc trích xuất từ 10 đề B1 và tài liệu luyện thi

part_1.question: What will the weather be like in the afternoon?
part_1.explanation: The speaker explicitly mentions that the rain will clear by midday, giving way to bright sunshine in the afternoon.
part_1.tapescript: Good morning. Rain will continue through the morning, but by 1 PM it will clear up, leaving us with a sunny and mild afternoon.

part_1.question: What time does the train to Oxford depart?
part_1.explanation: The announcement states the 9:15 train is cancelled, and the next available service to Oxford is at 9:45 from platform 3.
part_1.tapescript: Attention passengers: The 09:15 service to Oxford is cancelled. The next departure is scheduled for 09:45 at platform 3.

part_1.question: Where did the boy leave his backpack?
part_1.explanation: He remembers eating lunch with his friends and leaving his backpack on the chair next to him in the cafeteria.
part_1.tapescript: I thought I left it in the lab, but then I remembered sitting with Mark at lunch and leaving it right beside the cafeteria table.

part_1.question: How much did the woman pay for her jacket?
part_1.explanation: The original price was £70, but it was on a 50% discount sale, so she paid £35.
part_1.tapescript: It was originally marked at 70 pounds, but with the half-price weekend discount, I only paid thirty-five pounds.

part_1.question: Which activity did the family choose for Saturday?
options: B. Hiking in the national park
part_1.explanation: Despite the brother wanting to go to the cinema, the family agreed on hiking because of the clear forecast.
part_1.tapescript: My brother wanted cinema, but Dad suggested taking advantage of the crisp air to hike the national trail, which we all loved.

part_1.question: What is the girl ordering for dessert?
part_1.explanation: She decided to get the chocolate brownie with warm cream.
part_1.tapescript: I was tempted by the apple pie, but the chocolate brownie is their house specialty, so I will take that one.

part_1.question: Why was the flight delayed?
part_1.explanation: The captain announced visibility was below safety limits due to dense fog in Manchester.
part_1.tapescript: Due to thick fog covering Manchester airport, all incoming flights are held on the ground for an additional 40 minutes.

part_2.context: You will hear an interview with a young artist named Maya about her exhibition.
part_2.question: Maya started painting professionally when she was:
part_2.explanation: Maya mentions she painted as a child, but her first paid exhibition was right after turning 18.
part_2.tapescript: I drew as a kid, but only when I turned 18 did a local gallery take my collection and launch my professional journey.

part_2.context: You will hear a radio guide giving information about an eco-friendly holiday resort.
part_2.question: Guests at the resort are encouraged to:
options: A. Bring their own camping tents
B. Use electric bicycles provided free
part_2.explanation: The resort provides complimentary electric bikes to minimize carbon footprint within the reserve.
part_2.tapescript: To keep the valley quiet and clean, cars are parked at the gate, and each guest receives an electric bike free of charge.

part_2.context: You will hear a conservationist talking about sea turtle protection projects.
part_2.question: What is the primary danger to newly hatched turtles mentioned?
options: A. Beach illumination confusing their navigation
B. Plastic waste on the shoreline
part_2.explanation: Artificial lights from hotels disorient baby turtles away from the ocean towards the roads.
part_2.tapescript: Artificial lighting on beachfront resorts is the biggest threat as hatchlings instinctively move toward bright horizons.

part_3.context: Fill in the missing information for the Summer Cooking Workshop notes.
part_3.question: Workshop starting date: ______ July
part_3.explanation: The presenter mentions classes begin on the 15th of July.
part_3.tapescript: Registration closes on July 10th and our first kitchen session kicks off on the 15th of July.

part_3.context: Fill in the missing information for the City Library Membership Form.
part_3.question: Maximum number of books borrowed per card: ______
part_3.explanation: Under the new policy, standard membership allows up to 8 books at a time.
part_3.tapescript: We have increased the checkout allowance from six books to a maximum of eight books per patron.

part_3.context: Fill in the notes regarding the National Science Museum field trip.
part_3.question: Discounted group admission ticket price: £______ per student
part_3.explanation: School group tickets are reduced to 4.50 pounds per head.
part_3.tapescript: While standard admission is 9 pounds, verified school groups pay only 4 pounds 50 pence per student.

part_4.context: Listen to a conversation between Peter and Sarah about choosing university courses.
part_4.question: Sarah chose Computer Science primarily because:
options: B. She enjoys solving logical puzzles and coding
C. It offers the highest starting salary
part_4.explanation: Sarah highlights her passion for algorithms and logical problem-solving as her true motivation.
part_4.tapescript: Money is nice, but I've always loved tearing apart logical puzzles and writing mini-programs since middle school.

part_4.context: Listen to an interview with a marathon runner talking about mental endurance.
part_4.question: What technique does the runner use when feeling exhausted?
options: B. Breaking the remaining distance into tiny visual milestones
C. Thinking about the victory celebration
part_4.explanation: He focuses on reaching the next lamppost or tree rather than the full 42km.
part_4.tapescript: I never look at the finish banner in my mind; I just tell myself to get to that next street corner or tree.

part_1.context: NOTICE: 'Please keep all fire exit doors unobstructed at all times.'
part_1.question: What does this notice mean?
options: A. You must not place any items in front of the emergency doors.
B. Emergency doors should only be opened in winter.
C. Fire doors will be locked after 10 PM.
part_1.explanation: 'Unobstructed' means kept clear, without any obstacles or blocking items.

part_1.context: EMAIL: 'Hi Tom, Can you return the textbook you borrowed last Tuesday before the study group meets at 4 PM? - Lisa'
part_1.question: What is Lisa asking Tom to do?
options: A. Buy a new study textbook for the group.
B. Hand back her book prior to 4 PM.
C. Attend the study group on Tuesday.
part_1.explanation: Lisa asks him to return the borrowed book before 4 PM.

part_1.context: PARKING SIGN: 'Pay and Display: Free for the first 30 minutes, £2.00/hour thereafter.'
part_1.question: What is the parking condition?
options: A. Parking is always free of charge.
B. You must pay £2 immediately upon entering.
C. You do not have to pay if you stay under half an hour.
part_1.explanation: The first 30 minutes (half an hour) are free of charge.

part_1.context: AIRLINE MEMO: 'Passengers exceeding the 10kg carry-on allowance will incur a surcharge at the boarding gate.'
part_1.question: What should passengers understand?
options: A. Carry-on bags heavier than 10kg will require an additional fee.
B. All baggage must be checked in at the main counter.
part_1.explanation: 'Incur a surcharge' means having to pay an extra fee if overweight.

part_2.context: Profiles: Mark is an architect who loves modern urban design and prefers quiet cafes with rooftop terraces. Matching Options: [Cafe Horizon: Top-floor venue overlooking city skyscrapers, quiet ambient music, strict no-loud-call policy].
part_2.question: Which venue best matches Mark's profile?
part_2.explanation: Cafe Horizon meets all his requirements: rooftop terrace, modern city view, and quiet ambiance.

part_3.passage: Solar power technology has improved drastically in the last decade. Modern photovoltaic panels can generate electricity even under overcast skies, making solar energy a viable option for countries with less sunshine.
part_3.question: According to the passage, modern solar panels:
options: A. Only function in hot tropical climates
B. Are capable of producing energy on cloudy days
C. Have become more expensive to manufacture
part_3.explanation: 'even under overcast skies' corresponds to cloudy days.

part_3.passage: The rediscovery of ancient lost cities often hinges on satellite LiDAR scanning, which penetrates dense rainforest canopies to reveal hidden stone structures without disturbing the fragile ecological balance.
part_3.question: Why is LiDAR technology advantageous for archaeological discovery?
options: A. It physically removes tree branches from ancient ruins
B. It detects buried structures from above without damaging the jungle
C. It calculates the exact monetary value of artifacts
part_3.explanation: 'penetrates dense rainforest canopies... without disturbing the fragile ecological balance'.

part_4.passage: Working remotely has redefined corporate culture. While many employees report higher satisfaction due to reduced commuting times, managers frequently face hurdles in maintaining team cohesion and spontaneous brainstorming.
part_4.question: What is cited as a challenge of remote work?
options: A. Higher transport expenses for staff
B. Difficulties in fostering spontaneous collaboration among team members
C. Decreased flexibility in working hours
part_4.explanation: The text explicitly points to 'hurdles in maintaining team cohesion and spontaneous brainstorming'.

part_5.context: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. Thousands of climbers attempt to ______ the summit each spring.
part_5.question: Choose the best word to complete the blank:
part_5.explanation: 'Reach' is a transitive verb followed directly by an object ('reach the summit'). 'Arrive' needs 'at/in'.

part_5.context: Despite the heavy rain, the football match was not called ______, and players continued on the muddy pitch.
part_5.question: Choose the correct preposition:
part_5.explanation: Phrasal verb 'call off' means to cancel.

part_5.context: If she ______ harder during the semester, she would have passed the scholarship examination with flying colors.
part_5.question: Choose the correct grammatical form:
part_5.explanation: Third conditional for unreal past condition: If + Past Perfect (had worked), would have + V3/ed.

part_1_transformations.original: This smartphone is too expensive for me to purchase.
part_1_transformations.prompt: I do not have ____________________ to purchase this smartphone.
part_1_transformations.grammar_pattern: Too + adj -> Not enough + noun / Not + adj + enough
part_1_transformations.explanation: 'Too expensive' implies lacking sufficient financial resources ('not have enough money').

part_1_transformations.original: They built this bridge over two centuries ago.
part_1_transformations.prompt: This bridge ____________________ over two centuries ago.
part_1_transformations.explanation: Past Simple passive: was/were + V3 (was built).

part_1_transformations.original: "Do not forget to lock the front door," my mother told me.
part_1_transformations.prompt: My mother ____________________ lock the front door.

part_1_transformations.original: I haven't visited Paris for three years.
part_1_transformations.prompt: The last ____________________ Paris was three years ago.
part_1_transformations.grammar_pattern: Present Perfect to Past Simple with 'The last time...'
part_1_transformations.explanation: The last time + S + V(past) = Haven't + V3 + for [time].

part_1_transformations.original: Although the traffic was congested, we arrived at the airport on time.
part_1_transformations.prompt: In ____________________ traffic, we arrived at the airport on time.
part_1_transformations.grammar_pattern: Although + clause -> In spite of + noun phrase
part_1_transformations.explanation: In spite of is followed by a noun phrase: 'in spite of the congested traffic' or 'in spite of the traffic being congested'.

part_1_transformations.original: You will fail the exam unless you study consistently.
part_1_transformations.prompt: You will fail the exam ____________________ consistently.

part_2_messages.prompt: You are going on a weekend camping trip. Write an email (35-45 words) to your friend Alex. In your email: (1) Invite Alex to come along, (2) Tell him what gear to bring, (3) Suggest where to meet.
part_2_messages.sample_answer: Hi Alex, Would you like to join me for a camping trip this Saturday at Pine Lake? Please bring your warm sleeping bag and a flashlight. We can meet outside the central train station at 8:00 AM. Let me know soon! Best, Dan.

part_2_messages.prompt: Write a note (35-45 words) to your English teacher explaining why you missed yesterday's class, asking about homework assignments, and offering to submit your essay early.
part_2_messages.sample_answer: Dear Mrs. Green, I apologize for missing class yesterday due to a sudden fever. Could you please let me know which grammar exercises were assigned? I have already finished my essay and would like to email it to you today. Sincerely, Linh.

part_3_extended.prompt: Write a letter (about 100 words) to your penfriend telling them about your favorite festival in your country, why it is special to you, and how your family prepares for it.
part_3_extended.sample_outline: Opening -> Name of festival (e.g. Tet / Mid-Autumn) -> Family traditions & food -> Feelings & invitation to visit.

part_3_extended.prompt: Your story must begin with this sentence: 'When the train finally came to a stop in the middle of the tunnel, all the lights went out.' (Write about 100 words).
part_3_extended.sample_outline: Establish mood -> Reaction of passengers -> Action taken with phone torch -> Unexpected discovery -> Relieved resolution.

part_1: What do you like most about your neighborhood?
How do you usually travel to school or work?
topics.part_2_situation: You and a friend are planning a weekend activity in the city center. Discuss different options (visiting a museum, going to an escape room, cycling in the park) and decide on the best one.
part_3_discussion: Why is it important for cities to have green parks?
How has urban life changed compared to the past?

part_1: How many hours a day do you use your smartphone?
What apps do you find most useful for studying?
topics.part_2_situation: A class wants to create a digital project together. Discuss whether to make a podcast, a video blog (vlog), or an online magazine, and select one.
part_3_discussion: Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human teachers?
What are the drawbacks of spending too much time online?

part_1: What is your dream vacation destination?
topics.part_2_situation: A foreign tourist is visiting your hometown for only 24 hours. Discuss which places they should visit to experience local culture and cuisine.
part_3_discussion: How does traveling broaden a person's perspective?
What should tourists do to respect local traditions?
